caption: The drawing depicts a single garment resembling a coat or jacket, presented in a flat lay view with the sleeves outstretched to both sides. The coat is predominantly a muted mauve or dusty rose color, with decorative yellow or gold embroidery forming symmetrical, swirling, leaf-like patterns on the front, the bottom edges, and the sleeves near the cuffs. There are two large, rounded patch pockets on the lower front of the coat. The coat fastens with five round buttons running down the center, each button decorated with a yellow or gold pattern. Visible along the inner front edge of the coat is a vertical stripe of fabric with alternating blue, yellow, green, and reddish-brown bands. The background is plain and off-white, highlighting the details of the coat.
title: Child's Jacket
